description: LPT outlet temperature (T50) elevated above baseline, indicating turbine/combustion efficiency loss as the engine ages.

severityGuidance.moderate: Schedule cooling system and thermocouple inspection within 7 days.
severityGuidance.high: Immediate shutdown recommended; inspect cooling passages, seals, and combustor for damage.

recommendedAction: Inspect and service cooling system; check thermocouples and combustor liner for wear.

description: HPC outlet static pressure (Ps30) rising above baseline, consistent with reduced downstream flow capacity from blade fouling, erosion, or partial restriction in later compressor/turbine stages.

severityGuidance.moderate: Schedule seal and compressor inspection within 7 days.
severityGuidance.high: Immediate shutdown recommended; inspect seals and compressor stages for fouling or erosion.

recommendedAction: Inspect and clean compressor stages; check for seal wear and downstream restriction.

description: Corrected core speed (NRc) elevated above baseline, consistent with the engine's fuel control compensating for reduced compressor efficiency by spinning the core faster to maintain required thrust.

severityGuidance.moderate: Schedule drive-train and fuel control inspection within 7 days.
severityGuidance.high: Immediate shutdown recommended; inspect drive-train, governor, and fuel control unit.

recommendedAction: Inspect drive-train and fuel control unit; recalibrate governor.
